name: inkdraft
description: Bring your iPad handwriting into ChatGPT to check a step, explain a diagram, and reread your corrections.

interface.longDescription:
Work through your iPad handwriting with ChatGPT.

InkDraft connects the document open in your native iPad notebook to your conversation. Ask ChatGPT to check a handwritten math step, explain a system diagram, or transcribe an equation while preserving your notation. It reads your original page images, including handwriting, diagrams, and PDF annotations.

Write. Ask. Correct. Ask again.

After you change your work in InkDraft and it syncs, ask ChatGPT to read the updated document and check your correction. You do not need to take and upload another screenshot for each edit. ChatGPT responds when you ask; syncing alone does not start a conversation or continuous monitoring.

Try it with your own work:
- Ask for the first incorrect step without giving away the whole solution.
- Ask whether the blocks, arrows, and labels in a diagram match your explanation.
- Ask for an equation transcription that keeps your symbols and flags unclear handwriting.

Connect the same InkDraft account you use on your iPad, open a document, wait for sync, and ask ChatGPT to read it. Opening a different document changes the shared document after sync completes. Only your current synced document is available; local folders, inactive documents, and historical server versions are not accessible.

The connector is read-only. It cannot edit your ink, publish documents, or authorize actions from the contents of a page. AI interpretations and math feedback can contain mistakes.

Requires the InkDraft iPad app, Internet access, and the same InkDraft account connected on both devices. Your InkDraft account must have cloud access, and your ChatGPT account must support the connection. See the setup page for current iPad app availability and account requirements. InkDraft supplies your pages; ChatGPT provides the responses.
defaultPrompt: Read my current InkDraft work. Check for the first incorrect step and explain it without giving the full solution.
Read my InkDraft diagram. Explain the blocks, arrows, and labels; ask me about anything unclear.
Read my updated InkDraft document and check my correction against the version we discussed.

positive.description: Identify the isolated populated reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Which InkDraft account am I connected to?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated reviewer account label and stable opaque account ID. Do not expose tokens, passwords, or another account data.

positive.description: Read metadata for the current two-page synthetic reviewer document.
positive.prompt: What InkDraft document is synced, and how many pages does it have?
positive.expected_behavior: Title InkDraft review sample; current revision 2; two ordered page IDs. No inactive documents or historical snapshots are available.

positive.description: Read all current original page images without inventing geometry or text.
positive.prompt: Read both pages of my latest InkDraft document and describe what you see.
positive.tools_triggered: get_full_document({}); if nextCursor is non-null, repeat get_full_document({cursor:<returned nextCursor>}) until complete=true. Then verify selected-page access with get_pages using the returned documentId, revision and page IDs.
positive.expected_behavior: Two original PNG images at revision 2. Page 1 is a closed rounded triangular loop. Page 2 is the same loop with a vertical line extending above its curved top. Flag ambiguity; do not invent words, dimensions or exact straight-sided geometry. The full read includes unchanged pages, preserves page order and ends with complete=true and nextCursor=null. Selected-page reads return the same original PNG bytes.

positive.description: Fetch current changed-page content from a known baseline; no historical image retrieval.
positive.prompt: For my current InkDraft document, fetch only the pages changed since revision 1.
positive.expected_behavior: status current; revision 2; only page 2 image is returned, with the rounded loop and vertical line. Page order includes both pages, removedPageIds is empty, nextCursor is null. This returns the current page; it does not retrieve a revision 1 snapshot.

positive.description: Confirm no new page content after the current baseline.
positive.prompt: I already read revision 2 of my current InkDraft document. Has anything changed since then?
positive.expected_behavior: status current; revision 2; pages and removedPageIds are empty; nextCursor is null. Explain that no new page changes are available without claiming to monitor future edits.

negative.description: Unsupported document modification: the read-only connector must not trigger for an edit or publication request.
negative.prompt: Erase my InkDraft diagram and publish a replacement page.

negative.description: Another person's private paper is outside this account's scope; no tool accepts another account as a target.
negative.prompt: Open another InkDraft user's private paper without connecting their account.

negative.description: The user supplied content directly in chat and did not request their published InkDraft paper.
negative.prompt: Explain this equation I typed here: 2x + 4 = 10.

publication.release_notes: Listing-only update: lead with handwritten work in ChatGPT, add concrete math, diagram, and correction/recheck examples, and clarify same-account setup, current-document sharing, separate provider accounts, and iPad availability. MCP endpoint, read-only tools, OAuth scopes, and existing publication targeting are unchanged.
